scenario: 今天生成式推荐赛道有 10 篇，4 篇有深度解读，主线是把生成式推荐真正放到线上去跑。快手的 GR4AD-X 让广告召回按收入而不是生成概率来剪枝。阿里的 PFA 让长历史解码时所有 beam 共用一份重要行为排名，省下大部分注意力计算。淘宝的 UGR 把上千个跨业务候选直接生成为最终列表，跳过各业务分别排序再混排的环节。RoFiGR 用协同信息管住 SID 前几个码的大方向。另有用检索结果训练 query 生成器、树形 SFT、联邦推荐 agent、DoorDash 的生成式用户 embedding 等工作，以及一篇测出大模型推荐会被候选顺序左右的审计。做广告召回的团队可以先看 GR4AD-X 和 PFA，做混排的可以先看 UGR。

papers.title: Towards Reliable, Scalable, and Value-Aligned Generative Recommendation for Large-Scale Advertising
papers.authors: Yatong Xiao, Yibo Sheng, Lixiang Wang, Mingjie Sun, Yunhao Sha, Pengfei Zhang, Shengyu Wang, Peng Wang, Wenjin Wu, Peng Jiang
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) reformulates item retrieval as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs), offering a unified paradigm for personalized recommendation. GR4AD, as an industrial generative recommendation framework, has greatly improved advertising revenue while enabling efficient real-time serving in Kuaishou.However, continued deployment has exposed three limitations: deterministic SID assignment remains sensitive to semantic boundaries; conventional backbone scaling provides diminishing revenue gains under strict serving constraints; and sequence-level value optimization provides limited credit assignment to intermediate SID decisions, causing likelihood-based beam search to prematurely prune potentially high-value candidates. We present GR4AD-X, which addresses these limitations through reliable SID construction, serving-efficient capacity scaling, and unified value alignment. Specifically, GR4AD-X improves SID reliability through Multi-Path assig
papers.summary: 快手在已上线的生成式广告召回系统 GR4AD 上改了三处，合成 GR4AD-X，线上累计让广告收入比 GR4AD 高 3.07%。三处改动针对同一个错位：模型按生成概率挑广告，平台要的却是收入。按生成概率排出的前十名和 eCPM 最高的前十名几乎不重合，命中率只有约 0.02。第一处让每条广告在第一层保留两个最近的聚类中心，一个前缀被剪掉也还能召回。第二处不放大主干，而是从排序系统多接二十几个用户画像和上下文特征，并加宽关键特征的 embedding。第三处给每个 SID 前缀估收入价值，即它下面广告的平均收入；剪枝时用 RRF 按每个前缀在概率排名和价值排名里的名次合成一个分数，据此截断。==三处改动在线上逐个叠加验证==。

papers.title: PFA: Attention Can Be Progressively Focused in Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
papers.authors: Pengjie Zhou, Weiqin Yang, Haibo Xing, Hao Deng, Jinxin Hu
papers.abstract: Long user behavioral sequences improve the performance of generative recommendation (GR), but computing full attention over long histories during autoregressive beam search decoding incurs substantial online inference latency. To accelerate long-sequence decoding, existing approaches typically rely on static history compression or dynamic top-k sparse attention; however, the former risks losing critical semantics, whereas the latter incurs significant overhead from repeated token selection and non-contiguous memory access. In this work, we thoroughly analyze attention patterns during GR decoding and reveal two key properties: (i) progressive attention focusing, where attention progressively focuses on a small subset of critical historical tokens; and (ii) cross-step ranking consistency, where their importance rankings remain relatively stable across subsequent decoding steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Progressively Focused Attention (PFA), an efficient sparse decoding
papers.summary: 阿里的作者发现，生成式推荐做 beam 解码时，越往后注意力越集中在少数几条历史行为上，而且哪些行为重要，前后几步基本不变。据此提出的 PFA 把挑选重要历史这件事，从每步、每条 beam 各挑一次，改成整个解码只挑一次。它在解码第一步照常看完整历史；到第二步，把各条 beam 对历史的注意力按生成概率加权汇总，排出一份共用的重要行为排名，后面每步保留的行为数按固定比例缩小。在电商广告平台的线上 A/B 中，用户历史从 128 条加长到 512 条，收入提升 3.76%。响应时间仍比直接读完整历史更短。

papers.title: UGR: Unified Generative Ranking for Heterogeneous E-commerce Recommendation
papers.authors: Zonghe Shao, Huabin Chen, Sitong Lu, Fangmei Zhu, Yingcai Ma, Ge Fan, Jinguo Gao, Wei Shi, Yanfang Liu, Huiping Chu
papers.abstract: List-wise ranking in e-commerce recommendation must balance user utility and commercial value across organic content, ads, and candidates from other businesses, while modeling candidate interactions and sequential dependencies. Existing generative ranking methods typically learn from logged exposure sequences and operate on truncated candidate sets from a single business. Exposure-sequence learning may not fully exploit post-exposure feedback signals. Meanwhile, generative ranking over heterogeneous, multi-business candidates remains less explored, particularly when recommendation scores and advertising value must be jointly modeled under generalized second-price (GSP) auctions. We propose Unified Generative Ranking (UGR), which performs generative ranking over the full request-level multi-business heterogeneous candidate set, typically comprising around a thousand candidates in production, and directly generates multi-business ranking lists through candidate-aware autoregressive decod
papers.summary: 淘宝的生成式排序框架 UGR 让一个生成模型直接排出用户最后看到的那一屏：一次请求里约一千个自然内容、广告和其他业务的候选一起交给它，逐个生成最终列表，不再由各业务先各自排好、再交给混排拼接。拼接这一步正是原来的毛病：生成模型排好的列表被混排插进别的内容，位置和上下文都变了，模型学到的前后顺序就不成立了。在猜你喜欢的线上 A/B 中，成交量提升 3.29%；同一个模型只排自然内容、再交给原来的混排，成交量只涨 2.84%，==差出来的部分就是统一生成本身的收益==。

papers.title: RoFiGR: Coarse Routing, Fine Refinement via Level-Adaptive Distillation in Multimodal Generative Recommendation
papers.authors: Ji Dai, Zhipeng Wei, Zhuang Zhuang, Rongfeng Guo, Jie Chen, Quan Fang, Fei Pan
papers.abstract: Generative recommenders predict an item's semantic identifier (SID) one code at a time. Early codes select broad branches, so a routing error can exclude relevant items before fine-grained prediction begins. In multimodal recommendation, these coarse decisions must reflect collaborative preferences as well as item semantics. We introduce RoFiGR, a two-tree recommender that uses collaborative information in both SID construction and generation. It aligns cumulative L1-L2 code vectors with frozen collaborative item embeddings and explicitly encodes item distance and source level in the serialized history. During generation, a sequential teacher supervises legal branches. Fixed coarse-level weights maintain routing supervision, while a bounded adaptive residual allocates additional weight according to teacher-student demand. On Instruments, Arts, and Games, RoFiGR improves all five ranking metrics over the evaluated external baselines. Five-seed paired tests with Holm correction support t
papers.summary: 生成式推荐逐个码地生成物品的 SID，前两层码一旦选错大分支，后面再准也找不回相关物品；而多模态推荐里的 SID 多按图文语义构建，前几个码未必反映哪些物品常被同一批用户购买。这篇论文的 RoFiGR 因此把协同信息集中用在前两层码上。建 SID 时，它让每个物品前两层码向量之和，去贴近一个冻结的序列推荐模型（MISSRec）从用户行为里学到的同一物品的 embedding；生成时再用这个模型当老师：它给每个物品打分，一个分支下所有物品的概率加起来，就是这个分支该有的概率，学生每一步向它学。在三个亚马逊数据集上，五个排序指标（HR@10、NDCG@10 等）共 15 组比较全部领先，这 15 组相对最强基线的提升平均约 9.4%。

papers.title: R2QRec: Learning Recommendation Queries from Retrieval Feedback
papers.authors: Weixin Chen, Shuchang Liu, Hailan Yang, Yuhan Zhao, Li Kang, Xuefeng Zhang, Chenghao Zhang, Xinyuan Wang, Hanchen Yang, Yinghao Wu, Hua Huang, Yandong Bai, Fan Yang, Xiang Li, Chunjie Chen, Li Chen
papers.abstract: Query-based recommendation separates expressing user needs from locating matching items. Its central learning problem is how to turn item interactions into effective retrieval requests when interaction logs do not annotate queries. We present R2QRec, which uses a fixed retrieval system to construct query supervision and evaluate recommendation outcomes. Retrieval verification first selects generated expressions that recover observed items as supervised fine tuning targets, allowing retrieval behavior to determine the target wording. Policy refinement then evaluates generated query sets by the observed item's rank in their fused recommendation list. Log-rank feedback distinguishes outcomes beyond the recommendation cutoff, while a KL penalty constrains policy change relative to the supervised reference. The stages have distinct roles: verification identifies expressions to imitate, and policy refinement improves the combined ranking produced by newly generated queries. Only the query generator is trained; the retriever and item index remain fixed, and no query annotations or learned reward model are required. Across three public datasets, R2QRec achieves state-of-the-art overall recommendation performance among the evaluated methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design and its generalization across generators and domains.
papers.summary: 用大模型做推荐有一种思路：先根据用户历史写几条搜索 query，再交给现成的检索系统去找物品。难点在于日志里只有用户点了什么，没有当初该写什么 query。常见做法是拿被点物品的文字当目标去模仿，但这样写出的 query 未必能把这个物品检索出来。R2QRec 直接用一个固定的检索器来检验：先生成很多候选 query，只留下真能检索回被点物品的那些做 SFT；再让模型一次写一组 query，每条各检索出一个列表，用 RRF 合成一个推荐列表，GRPO 按被点物品在这个列表里的排名给奖励。只训练 query 生成器，检索器和物品索引都不动。在 MovieTV 上，去掉检索检验这一步，NDCG@10 从 5.07% 掉到 4.03%。

papers.title: Statistical Detection of Positional Bias in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: Methodologies and Empirical Evidence
papers.authors: Carlos Peláez-González, Francisco Herrera, Andrés Herrera-Poyatos
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as recommendation generators in conversational recommender systems (RS) via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This flexible design introduces new sources of structural bias. This paper studies positional bias in top-1 and single-turn LLM-based RS: systematic dependence of the recommended item on the order in which candidates are presented in the prompt. We propose two complementary detection methodologies: (i) POB-ICM, based on contingency matrix analysis and Chi-square independence testing, and (ii) POB-UNBP, a sample-efficient approach derived from a uniformity null model under permutation-based evaluation, enabling stochastic decoding with formal statistical guarantees. Using a controlled RAG testbed for product recommendation, built on a real product catalog, a fixed prompt template and 2000 template-generated user queries with 20 permutations each (40,000 instances), both methodologies reject the null hypothesis of positional
papers.summary: 把候选商品写进提示词、让大模型挑一个推荐，候选的排列顺序本身就会改变它的选择。作者在一个真实商品目录上搭了 RAG 推荐测试，同一条 query 把候选顺序反复打乱，测了 8 个模型，统计检验在每个模型上都确认推荐结果和位置有关。各家偏向不同：GPT-OSS 偏爱排在前面的，LLaMA 4 Scout 反而避开第一个。候选越多越严重。给 20 个候选时，只是打乱顺序，DeepSeek R1 7B 就有 58.1% 的推荐和它对同一条 query 最常给出的那件商品不一样。==顺序带来的偏差取决于模型本身，换温度也去不掉==，用大模型做推荐时值得把候选顺序随机化，并定期做这类检查。

papers.title: Merge and Branch: Efficient Tree-Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning of LLMs for Recommendation
papers.abstract: LLM-based generative recommendation reads long, text-rich interaction histories but generates only short semantic identifiers (SIDs). This asymmetry makes supervised fine-tuning inefficient: encoding the history is expensive, yet each history usually provides supervision for only one target. We present Merge and Branch (M&B) to reduce input cost and learn more from each encoded history. Merge compresses each historical item's SID and text into a small number of learned tokens. Branch uses the compressed history to predict multiple target SIDs. To share history computation while keeping these targets independent, M&B organizes each example as a shallow, wide tree. We develop tree FlashAttention to execute this layout efficiently, processing the shared history once and propagating gradients from every branch for end-to-end training. A tree-structured key/value cache extends history sharing to constrained decoding. Experiments on public benchmarks show that M&B outperforms strong recommen
papers.summary: 用大模型做生成式推荐时，输入是一长串带文字的历史，输出却只是几个 token 的 SID。训练时费力读完一整段历史，往往只学一个目标物品。M&B 第一步把每条历史物品压成少数几个 token：先把它各层 SID 码的 embedding 合成一个锚点向量，再分别加上几个可学习的偏移向量作为查询，对物品的 SID 和文字 token 做注意力；每个查询取回的内容再加回锚点向量上，就成了一个 token。第二步让压缩后的历史同时预测多个目标：下一个物品、更往后的物品和老师模型推荐的物品，这些目标像树枝一样共用同一段历史，彼此看不见。解码时各条 beam 也共用历史 KV cache。==历史只算一次，每个分支都能回传梯度==。历史长度为 512 时，beam 解码的显存少了 61.8%，延迟少了约一成。

papers.title: Federated Recommender Agents
papers.authors: Jaehyung Lim, Woojoo Kim, Junyoung Kim, Dongha Kim, Wonbin Kweon, Hwanjo Yu
papers.abstract: LLM-powered recommender agents use reasoning and memory for personalization, but centralized access to user information raises privacy concerns, while isolated agents cannot learn from others' experiences. We formulate Federated Recommender Agents, a setting where local agents collaborate through natural-language knowledge while keeping interaction histories and personal memories local. We propose FedRecAgent, which enables this collaboration without updating LLM parameters. Its central challenge is determining which reasoning to integrate, since similar behavioral contexts can lead to different choices. FedRecAgent represents local experiences as Condition-Transition-Reasoning (C-T-R) units and hierarchically integrates reasoning by condition and transition. Within this structure, it consolidates related explanations and discriminates reasoning across alternative transitions. Each client maintains semantic and decision memories to capture preferences and conditional choice tendencies,
papers.summary: 用大模型 agent 做推荐，集中所有用户的记忆有隐私问题，各自为战又学不到别人的经验。FedRecAgent 让每个用户端的 agent 只上传用自然语言写的经验，不上传交互记录，也不更新模型参数。每条经验写成三段：当时处在什么情境，用户下一步怎么选（接着看当前感兴趣的那类、回到以前喜欢的、还是换个新方向），以及为什么这样选。具体物品和个人偏好都去掉。服务器按文本相似度，把情境相近的经验归成一组，组里选择也相近的合并，选择不同的分开保存。推荐时，用户端先找与当前情境最接近的一组，再按本地的偏好和选择习惯记忆挑出组里最贴近的几条，由模型选一条辅助排序。在六个数据集上，最好的版本比最强基线的 NDCG@10 高 1.54% 到 9.19%。

papers.title: PALATE: Pretrained Autoregressive LATent Embeddings
papers.authors: Sizhang Zhao, Praveen Gondhi, Bin Li, Utsaw Kumar
papers.abstract: Local-commerce and food-delivery marketplaces run large ads businesses: across hundreds of thousands of stores, merchants pay to be surfaced on browse and search surfaces, and a ranker decides which ads each consumer sees. Ranking well demands strong per-consumer personalization, yet a consumer's raw interaction history is sparse and high-cardinality. Our production ranker had personalized only through hand-engineered signals: aggregate engagement counts, categorical embeddings, and order-agnostic pooled history, with no learned per-consumer sequence representation. We learn one by training a GPT-style generative model of the consumer's engagement sequence to predict their next few engagements, and read its last-token hidden state as the consumer embedding. That single frozen vector becomes one shared personalization input for every ad surface: a daily job refreshes it, and each ranker consumes it as an ordinary dense feature. Offline it is the largest single-feature gain in our ranking-AUC ladder, a relative Eval-AUC gain of +0.59% on a browse-driven feed and +0.57% on a query-driven search surface. Online, it shipped as one component of bundled ranker retrains on both surfaces: Discovery (revenue +0.79%, conversion rate +1.17%) and Search (revenue +0.94%, conversion rate +1.50%). Three design choices adapt the generative objective to a repurchase-heavy marketplace, and are the core of our contribution: an exploration-weighted loss that up-weights businesses new to the consumer over ones already engaged; a two-stage curriculum: a click pretrain that keeps the representation broad and exploratory, then a conversion fine-tune that sharpens purchase intent; and a designed negative set that pairs a fixed popular-business pool and businesses shown but not ordered with random and in-batch negatives.
papers.summary: 外卖和本地生活平台的广告排序要做到千人千面，但用户的行为历史很稀疏，店铺又有几十万家。DoorDash 原来的排序模型只靠手工统计特征和不分先后的历史汇总，没有一个学出来的用户序列表示。PALATE 训练一个 GPT 式模型，根据用户的行为序列预测接下来会和哪些店铺互动，取最后一个位置的隐藏状态当用户 embedding，每天刷新一次，作为普通特征喂给各个广告位的排序模型。因为复购多，训练时给用户没去过的新店更高权重，先用点击预训练，再用下单微调。离线它是单个特征里 AUC 涨得最多的；上线时随排序模型的整体重训一起发布，搜索广告收入提升 0.94%，转化率提升 1.50%。

papers.title: Category-Anchored Large Language Models for Next POI Recommendation
papers.authors: Lexi Bai, Xiaopeng Zeng, Xun Zhou, Yuanshao Zhu, James Jianqiao Yu
papers.abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation aims to predict a user's next destination from spatio-temporal check-in data, and serves as the foundation for many location-based services. Recent advances incorporate large language models (LLMs) into this task by textualizing user trajectories to exploit their semantic reasoning ability. However, directly generating POI identifiers with such models is unreliable: POIs are sparse, localized, and long-tailed entities with weak natural-language semantics, which creates a semantic-to-entity gap between high-level mobility intent and concrete POI prediction. To bridge this gap, we propose ANCHOR, a category-anchored framework for semantic-to-entity grounding in next POI recommendation. Specifically, ANCHOR first estimates category-level mobility intent in a compact and stable semantic space, rather than predicting concrete POI entities directly. The inferred intent is then grounded into a candidate set by integrating three complementary sources
papers.summary: 预测用户下一个要去的地点（POI）时，直接让大模型生成地点 ID 并不可靠：地点多、分散、长尾严重，名字本身也没多少语义。ANCHOR 换了个顺序，先让大模型预测用户接下来想去哪一类地方，类别数量少、含义稳定，更好预测；再从三路凑出候选，分别是这一类的地点、用户去过的地点，以及用户长期、近期和对应时段偏爱的类别下的地点；最后用一个参照历史轨迹的重排模型选出具体地点。==先猜类别再落到地点，比直接猜地点稳==。在纽约、东京和加州三个签到数据集上，它的 Acc@1 比最强的大模型基线 Think2Go 分别高 7.56%、11.21% 和 1.94%。
